, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to effectively navigate and extract shipping rate information from the USPS website. Instead of directly accessing and utilizing the USPS International Shipping Calculator, the agent repeatedly returned to search results and did not successfully complete the task. This failure to obtain the necessary data from the USPS site led to the inability to determine the cheapest shipping option, ultimately impacting the resolution of the problem.
